g.text: Programming pads on the flat bottom side: VMCU, GND, SWDIO, SWCLK, NRST (pogo jig).

g.desc: Programming pads on the flat bottom side: VMCU, GND, SWDIO, SWCLK, NRST (pogo jig).

g.text: R6 keeps the buzzer off while the MCU resets.

g.desc: R6 keeps the buzzer off while the MCU resets.

g.text: Click: S8050 switches the passive buzzer from VBUS. D2 catches the coil kick.

g.desc: Click: S8050 switches the passive buzzer from VBUS. D2 catches the coil kick.

g.text: Two reverse-gullwing phototransistors look through holes in the board (display mode).

g.desc: Two reverse-gullwing phototransistors look through holes in the board (display mode).

g.text: PY32 runs from 5 V directly (VCC 1.7-5.5 V, abs max 6.25 V). R3/C2 filter VBUS spikes.

g.desc: PY32 runs from 5 V directly (VCC 1.7-5.5 V, abs max 6.25 V). R3/C2 filter VBUS spikes.

g.text: COMP2 compares SENS_A (PA3, +) with SENS_B (PA2, -). The ADC reads the same pins for dark/light.

g.desc: COMP2 compares SENS_A (PA3, +) with SENS_B (PA2, -). The ADC reads the same pins for dark/light.

g.text: USB-C power only: the phone supplies 5 V because of the 5.1k pull-downs on CC1/CC2. D+/D- are not on this receptacle.

g.desc: USB-C power only: the phone supplies 5 V because of the 5.1k pull-downs on CC1/CC2. D+/D- are not on this receptacle.

g.text: White reverse-mount LED shines through a hole in the board (camera mode). About 12 mA from PA5.

g.desc: White reverse-mount LED shines through a hole in the board (camera mode). About 12 mA from PA5.
